name: Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE)
terms: Written permission is needed to reproduce the items; a fee per form. A site keeps the total only unless it holds a licence.

name: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA)
terms: Training and certification are required since 2019 (a fee; free for academics); institutional licences are offered; commercial terms are not published.

name: Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR)
terms: The CDR 'requires a license whether ... for-profit or non-profit'. The catalogue keeps the global and box scores, never the worksheet text; a licence is needed before the scoring algorithm ships.

name: MDS-UPDRS (and the 1987 UPDRS)
holder: International Parkinson and Movement Disorder Society
terms: Permission per study, protocol and language; a fee for industry use.

name: ADAS-Cog (11 or 13)
terms: The copyright and permission terms were not confirmed from a public source. Treated as score-only until they are.

name: EQ-5D
terms: Use, reproduction or change needs the Foundation's consent; free for non-commercial use after registration; a licence fee for commercial use. Not in the catalogue: nothing of it can be stored until an item is added.

name: SF-36 Health Survey
holder: the commercial version's owner; RAND for the RAND-36
terms: The commercial SF-36 is scored with bought software, priced by the number of scores. The RAND-36 has the same items and is public domain, with its own scoring. Not in the catalogue.

name: Dermatology Life Quality Index (DLQI)
terms: Free for not-for-profit and academic non-commercial use; a licence with a charge for other uses including clinical trials.

name: COPD Assessment Test (CAT)
terms: Permission is required (CDISC was refused). The catalogue keeps the score only.

name: Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale (PANSS)
terms: A licence is said to be required; the terms were not confirmed from a public source.

name: FACT and FACIT measures (FACT-G and modules)
terms: Use needs a licence obtained by registering; no change or translation without permission; the copyright line on every page used; an online form behind a password or a restricted link. Not in the catalogue.

name: EORTC QLQ-C30 and modules
terms: Written prior consent per study, academic use included; a fee when a for-profit body sponsors or funds the study; electronic use is a clause of the agreement. Not in the catalogue.

name: PROMIS measures
terms: Use is free under the PROMIS terms; no permission to change the wording or layout of items, to translate them or to distribute them to others; publications name the instruments and versions. Not in the catalogue.

name: Pediatric Quality of Life Inventory (PedsQL)
terms: A licence fee for funded studies.

name: Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score v3 and Vasculitis Damage Index
BILAG-2004 index
terms: The licence terms were not confirmed from a public source. Treated as score-only until they are.

name: FRAX fracture risk
terms: Integrating FRAX in software is said to need a licence; not confirmed from a public source. Treated as score-only.

name: AJCC cancer staging
terms: AJCC content in EHR or other software needs a licence. A recorded stage value may be stored; the staging tables are never embedded without a licence.
